name: Darsok Swiftdagger offers Harpy Raiders from level 12 (#142)
contract: Darsok Swiftdagger 3449 (spawn 14415, Crossroads tower top, map 1 -474.894 -2607.74 127.885) is a quest giver
(npcflag 2) for Harpy Raiders 867 and its chain 875, 876, 1060. Quest 867 has MinLevel 12, QuestLevel 15 and
AllowableRaces 690. GetQuestDialogStatus shows the grey unavailable marker (1) to a Horde player below MinLevel,
and the available marker (8) once the level is met. Expected: a level 11 orc sees 1 and cannot take 867; a
level 12 orc sees 8 and can take it. Each orc talks to its own Darsok, since the lane phase hides the world
